description: Price meetings in money and focus — the attendee-hours × loaded-rate math, the recurring multiplier that turns a weekly 30-minutes into a real annual number, and the cost-vs-outcome read that decides what the price buys. Use when asked what does this meeting cost, price our meeting culture, is this recurring meeting worth it, or make the case for fewer attendees.
